business_summary: Shanghai Sanmao Enterprise (Group) Co., Ltd. imports and exports clothing and textile products in China and internationally. It also provides customized long-term and short-term security services, including fixed-point security, unarmed security, personal security, security escort for large-scale events, and evacuation support for specific groups for universities, large amusement parks, financial institutions, government agencies, office parks, and other diverse organizations. In addition, the company offers property leasing for industrial, warehousing, and office purposes; and industrial park property leasing and management services. Further, it is involved in e-commerce, investment consulting, and investment management activities; import and export of goods and technology; and provision of labor, gatekeeper, patrol, and bodyguard services. Shanghai Sanmao Enterprise (Group) Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Shanghai Sanmao Textile Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
